question: Muneer ran 340 steps towards north and then ran 90 steps after turning to his left. He then ran 130 steps towards his right. He then, turned towards his right and ran 90 steps. From there, he turned towards his right and ran another 240 steps. How far and in which direction is Muneer with respect to the starting point?
solution: Given: Muneer ran 340 steps towards north and then ran 90 steps after turning to his left. He then ran 130 steps towards his right. He then, turned towards his right and ran 90 steps. From there, he turned towards his right and ran another 240 steps.
